 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 🦚 Peacock Pyrite–Lapis Luxury Crystal Clock

Elegance, Energy & Good Fortune — All in One Timeless Masterpiece

Introducing the Peacock Pyrite–Lapis Clock, a statement piece crafted for those who appreciate art, luxury, and powerful crystal energies.This handcrafted clock features:

• 
Pyrite, the crystal of wealth, success, and prosperity

• 
Lapis Lazuli, the crystal of wisdom, protection, and truth

• 
A regal peacock motif, symbolising royalty, confidence & positive transformation

Hanged on a wall, this clock doesn’t just tell time — it elevates the aura of your entire home, radiates protection, and attracts abundance.

A true décor masterpiece from India’s biggest crystal home décor brand.

Please Note: The clock needles/hands may vary slightly depending on availability. Rest assured, the overall design, quality, and functionality remain unaffected.”

 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 1. Are the crystals real?

Yes. The Pyrite and Lapis used are tested, certified & authenticated for quality and energy resonance.

2. What is the best direction to place this clock?

North, North-East, or South-East are ideal for growth, clarity, and prosperity.

3. Can I keep it on my work desk?

Absolutely — it enhances focus, confidence & financial success.

4. Is it suitable for gifting?

Yes, it is a premium luxury gift perfect for housewarmings, weddings, offices, festivals & corporate gifting.

5. How to clean the clock?

Use a dry microfiber cloth only. Avoid water or chemicals.

6. Will the peacock design fade?

No. The design is sealed with high-grade resin for long-lasting shine.
